messages.subject: Question - Phylogenetic Tree Chap 8
parts:
Dear all,

I am using the wondefull book about "Data Integration, Manipulation and Visualization of Phylogenetic Trees" https://yulab-smu.github.io/treedata-book/index.html and I have a question about your guide at "Chapter 8 Annotating Tree with Silhouette Images and Sub-plots".

I use the source code as below and I have two problems :

1) I do not understand what to do with to fix the function 'full_join'

> tree2 <- full_join(tree, data.frame(label = names(x), stat = x ), by = 'label')
Error in UseMethod("full_join") :
  no applicable method for 'full_join' applied to an object of class "c('simmap', 'phylo')"

2) Why RStudio did not find the function geom_inset while I loaded (I think) the suitable libraries ?

> ?geom_inset
No documentation for ‘geom_inset’ in specified packages and libraries:
you could try ‘??geom_inset’


###This is the code
library(phytools)
library(ape)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
library(phytools)
library(ggtree)
library(treeio)
library(ggimage)



data(anoletree)
x <- getStates(anoletree,"tips")
tree <- anoletree


cols <- setNames(palette()[1:length(unique(x))],sort(unique(x)))
fitER <- ape::ace(x,tree,model="ER",type="discrete")
ancstats <- as.data.frame(fitER$lik.anc)
ancstats$node <- 1:tree$Nnode+Ntip(tree)

## cols parameter indicate which columns store stats
bars <- nodebar(ancstats, cols=1:6)
bars <- lapply(bars, function(g) g+scale_fill_manual(values = cols))

tree2 <- ggtree:full_join(tree, data.frame(label = names(x), stat = x ), by = 'label')
p <- ggtree(tree2) + geom_tiplab() +
  geom_tippoint(aes(color = stat)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols) +
  theme(legend.position = "right") +
  xlim(NA, 8)
p + geom_inset(bars, width = .08, height = .05, x = "branch")


Thanks you for helping,

Kinds regards,

Grégoire

messages.author: 2a4584b898b0bd00
messages.subject: Re: Question - Phylogenetic Tree Chap 8
parts:
For Q1, we didn't provide full_join method for simmap object.
For Q2, you need to upgrade ggtree to latest release version.
